text: A Song of Ascents; of David. Behold, how good{H2896} and how pleasant{H5273} it is For brethren{H251} to dwell{H3427} together{H3162} in unity!{H3162}

It is like the precious{H2896} oil{H8081} upon the head,{H7218} That ran down{H3381} upon the beard,{H2206} Even Aaron's{H175} beard;{H2206} That came down{H3381} upon the skirt{H6310} of his garments;{H4060}

Like the dew{H2919} of Hermon,{H2768} That cometh down{H3381} upon the mountains{H2042} of Zion:{H6726} For there Jehovah{H3068} commanded{H6680} the blessing,{H1293} Even life{H2416} for evermore.{H5769}
